overall: Informal resolution finding no violation: the notice listed the Board of Health seat as "TBD", and the member appointed to it was not anticipated when the notice was posted.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Board violated the OML by appointing a Board member to the Board of Health without listing him as a candidate on the meeting notice.
allegations.key_passage: We credit the Board’s assertion that Selectman Heim’s appointment to the Board of Health was not anticipated at the time notice was posted, and we therefore find no violation of the Open Meeting Law.
